children: Evolution Mining is smart to have acquired Carnaby Resources, a deal that completed earlier this week, Macquarie says. It might not be a headline-grabbing, large-scale takeover, but it is logical and value-accretive, Macquarie says. Still, the bank thinks it is baked into Evolution's share price, which has nearly tripled since the start of last year. "While we remain constructive on the asset quality and longer-term growth outlook for EVN, we believe the current valuation appropriately captures these opportunities," says Macquarie. It lifts its target price on Evolution by 2% to 13.20 Australian dollars and reiterates a neutral rating. The stock is down 1.9% at A$13.16. (rhiannon.hoyle@wsj.com; @RhiannonHoyle)
